row.title: Spin-one Haldane gap
row.statement: The quantity is the uniform periodic spin-one spectral-gap lower bound \(\gamma_L\) at \(J=1\), compared on the original domain of even \(L\ge2304\). A higher lower bound is better. The claim assumes the cited OpenAI spatial-transfer identities and certified finite inputs. The extension to every integer \(L\ge24\) is listed under Relevant repos.

relevantRepos.name: amachino/haldane-gap-refinement
relevantRepos.note: The extension includes every integer length at least 24.
